name: Power Power Supply — TSSOP
description: A collection of 7 surface-mount power supply and battery management components in TSSOP and exposed-pad HTSSOP packages.
selection_hints: Match the required pin count and exposed thermal pad dimensions (EP) for HTSSOP or standard TSSOP variants.
Prioritize Tier A parts such as BQ76200PW and BQ78350DBT for high-confidence symbol-footprint pairings.
Verify the lead pitch (0.5mm or 0.65mm) against board fabrication rules.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or packages other than TSSOP and HTSSOP are needed.
The required pin count or package dimension is not among the available footprint options.
The application requires circuitry outside of power supply and battery management functions.
